raw_layer_policy: No same-title or cross-work merging in raw data; every round/entry remains traceable.

status_definitions.available_crawled: The official component is offered and all currently expected files for it are present.
status_definitions.available_local_substitute: Only a deliberately redundant ranking view is satisfied by a hash/header/row-validated local workbook; it is not an official HTTP response.
status_definitions.official_not_offered: The official navigation/interface for this round does not offer this component.
status_definitions.fetch_failed: The official component is offered but one or more expected files are missing or a transient fetch failed; rerun is safe.
